camera_off.requirement: camera disabled before room cruise validation

health_ok.requirement: sensor health OK, safety allow true, watchdog not stopped

idle_no_motion.requirement: IDLE state, zero command/PWM, no relevant measured creep

lidar_ready.requirement: front clearance and LIDAR confidence ready for movement

logger_ready.requirement: logger has no drops/write errors and bounded queue/flush latency

required_peripherals.requirement: lidar, encoder, imu, accelerometer and gyroscope enabled

actual_primitive_classifier.requirement: enough ready/reliable settled measurements match the exact primitive, or a physically passing STRAIGHT segment contains only executor-owned gentle straight-hold corrections; settled contract violations are forbidden

motion_evidence.requirement: bounded live twist primitive produces enough active samples without timeout

physical_twist_quality.requirement: straight moves forward with low heading drift; arc moves forward while turning in the requested direction

primitive_command_chain.requirement: requested, limited and executed primitive match the expected straight/arc family
